title: The Ward Who Will Not Eat
text: Your youngest has stopped eating. They sit at the window facing the Gate, and when they speak it is in a language nobody in the Seat knows, though the dogs seem to. The priest says something is speaking through them. The scholar says to let it finish.

options.label: Pay the priest to drive it out.

outcomes.text: The priest prays for three days. On the fourth, your youngest asks for bread, and eats it, and cries. They remember nothing.

options.label: Let it finish, and have the scholar write it down.

outcomes.text: It speaks for a week and then stops. Your youngest wakes thin and strange and full of words that open doors in other languages.

options.label: Feed them by spoon, and wait it out.

outcomes.text: It leaves in its own time. Your youngest eats again. They still face the Gate when they sleep.
